name: Daily Taiwan Eligible Async Remote Job Hunter

parameters.content:
## Daily Taiwan Eligible Async Remote Job Hunter

Runs every day at 08:30 Asia/Taipei.

Pipeline: Sources -> Normalize -> Dedupe -> Raw Jobs sheet -> Taiwan hard filter -> AI Taiwan eligibility check (Claude) -> Async filter -> Role fit -> Scoring -> Final decision -> Filtered/Rejected sheets -> Telegram + Gmail digest -> cover letter draft for score >= 85.

See n8n/README.md in the repo for required credentials and setup.

### Sources

RemoteOK (API), Remotive (API, per-keyword), Himalayas (API, per-keyword), We Work Remotely (RSS x3 categories).

Wellfound, YC Work at a Startup, Otta and Dynamite Jobs do not expose a public API/RSS and are JS-rendered / login-gated, so they are NOT wired up live here (a plain HTTP Request can't read them). See the disabled placeholder + sticky note below for how to add them via a scraping service (e.g. Apify) if you want full coverage.

### Filter & scoring order

1) Keyword hard filter (free, no AI call) rejects obvious non-Taiwan jobs.
2) Claude AI check judges the remaining jobs for real Taiwan eligibility.
3) Async keyword filter.
4) Role fit scoring.
5) Scoring node combines everything (Taiwan/async/role/salary tiers, capped at 100).
6) Final decision node applies the apply/manual_check/reject rules from the spec.

Assumption (undocumented in the original spec): async/role/salary tiers are MAX-of-tier, not additive, so the score stays bounded near 100.

### Before you run this

1. Add credentials: Anthropic API (HTTP Header Auth), Google Sheets OAuth2, Telegram Bot (optional), Gmail OAuth2 (optional).
2. Create the 'Taiwan Eligible Async Remote Jobs' Google Sheet with the 4 tabs described in n8n/README.md and wire the documentId/sheetName on every Google Sheets node.
3. Set JERRY_EMAIL / TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID in n8n environment variables (or hardcode in the relevant nodes).
4. Run once manually with 'Execute workflow' before trusting the schedule.

parameters.jsCode:
const keywords = ["async remote", "asynchronous remote", "worldwide remote", "global remote", "work from anywhere", "remote data analyst", "remote data scientist", "remote AI marketing", "remote marketing analyst", "remote growth analyst", "remote BI analyst", "remote automation specialist", "remote AI workflow consultant"];
return keywords.map(k => ({ json: { keyword: k } }));

parameters.content:
Wellfound, YC 'Work at a Startup' and Otta require a logged-in, JS-rendered session; Dynamite Jobs has no documented public feed. A plain HTTP Request node returns an empty shell for all of them.

To include them: point this disabled node at a scraping service (e.g. an Apify actor via HTTP Request with your APIFY_TOKEN) that returns job_title/company/job_url/description, then feed its output into the same 'Normalize All' node below, and re-enable it.

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({
  model: 'claude-sonnet-5',
  max_tokens: 400,
  messages: [{ role: 'user', content:
    'You are filtering remote jobs for Jerry, who lives in Taiwan.

' +
    'The most important rule:
' +
    'Jerry must be able to work this job while physically based in Taiwan.

' +
    'Do not pass the job only because it says “remote.”

' +
    'Reject the job if it requires the worker to live in the US, Canada, UK, EU, Europe, Australia, or any specific country outside Taiwan.
' +
    'Reject the job if it requires local work authorization outside Taiwan.
' +
    'Reject the job if it is hybrid, onsite, or remote within one country only.
' +
    'Reject the job if it requires fixed working hours that would force Jerry to work through the night in Taiwan.

' +
    'Keep the job only if one of these is true:
' +
    'The job says worldwide remote.
' +
    'The job says work from anywhere.
' +
    'The job says global remote.
' +
    'The job says APAC remote.
' +
    'The job allows international contractors.
' +
    'The job accepts people based anywhere.
' +
    'The company hires through EOR, Deel, Remote.com, Oyster, or contractor agreement.

' +
    'Return JSON only:
' +
    '{
"taiwan_eligible": "yes/no/unclear",
"reason": "short reason",
"location_risk": "low/medium/high",
"timezone_risk": "low/medium/high",
"contractor_possible": "yes/no/unclear",
"decision": "keep/reject/manual_check"
}

' +
    'Job post:
' + ($json.description || $json.job_title || '')
  }]
}) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({
  model: 'claude-sonnet-5',
  max_tokens: 500,
  messages: [{ role: 'user', content:
    'Write a short cover letter for Jerry.

' +
    'Jerry is based in Taiwan and wants async global remote work.

' +
    'Use this background:
' +
    'Bilingual English and Mandarin. Grew up in California and Taiwan. Digital marketing background. Data science bootcamp experience. Python, SQL, Tableau, Power BI. Performance marketing, SEO, PPC, GA4, Meta Ads, Google Ads. AI tools: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor. Experience with dashboards, EDA, machine learning projects, customer segmentation, fraud detection, and marketing analytics.

' +
    'Make the letter specific to this job.

' +
    'Mention how Jerry can help the company: reduce manual analysis time, improve reporting speed, connect marketing and data, build AI-assisted workflows, turn messy data into business action.

' +
    'Keep it under 220 words. Tone: confident, direct, human, not desperate.

' +
    'Job title: ' + $json.job_title + '
' +
    'Company: ' + $json.company + '
' +
    'Job post:
' + ($json.description || '')
  }]
}) }}
